title: Ceramic Stash Jar – Donut
description:
The stash jar is made of ceramic in the shape of three stacked donuts. With a cork lid, the jar can be used to stash herb, spice, medicine, coffee, tea and keep them fresh and sealed for months. This fun stash jar comes in an acetate box and makes a super cool gift.
– Dimensions: (L) 76.2 x (W) 76.2 x (H) 101.6 mm
